Success Stories

Whenever productivity and robustness are called for, a diesel forklift truck from Linde Material Handling is just the ticket. Load capacity from 1.4 to 18 tonnes: Diesel forklift trucks can easily transport enormous loads in continuous operation, even under the harshest conditions. What's more, all diesel models from Linde offer maximum handling performance with minimum fuel consumption. This is what makes these trucks an indispensable aid for outdoor usage scenarios.
Constructed for excellent handling performance in tight spaces: the H16 – H20 IC trucks are suitable for a wide variety of uses.
Networked All-Rounders: The H20 – H35 IC trucks are extremely versatile, and can easily be integrated into local software systems.
Powerful All-Rounders: The H35 – H50 IC trucks really come into their own in demanding applications in the middleweight class where continuous operation is required.
Whether it's paper, bricks, or construction materials: If heavy loads need moving quickly and precisely, the H50 – H80 IC trucks feel right at home
Power plus visibility: Thanks to their excellent field of view and hydrodynamic drive, the HT100 – HT180 D trucks are particularly well suited to occasional use.

Whether it's in the metal industry, wholesale, or goods transport in outdoor warehouses, whenever things get tough in the open air, Linde diesel forklifts are in their element. This is largely thanks to the robustness of their powerful diesel engine, which can tolerate all extremes of heat and cold. Diesel forklift trucks can even put in a first-class performance in wet, muddy, or extremely dusty environments. These robust trucks effortlessly conquer steep gradients, and even perform exceptionally when heavy loads must be repeatedly transported over long distances. Thanks to their huge ground clearance, even uneven terrain can't stop them in their tracks.

When it comes to the safety of the driver, their load, and the environment, Linde forklifts leave nothing to chance. To start with, the trucks are equipped with numerous protection systems as standard. In addition, their low center of gravity ensures good stability when cornering. The cab roof and frame form a spacious, enclosed protection zone. The driver's cab with all-round visibility and a range of assistance systems provide additional protection. For example, Linde Curve Assist prevents the truck moving at an excessive speed around bends.

All internal combustion forklift trucks from Linde Material Handling can be run on HVO fuel. HVO stands for “hydrotreated vegetable oil” and is made from 100 percent renewable raw materials, such as waste and residues. Companies with diesel fleets can reduce their carbon emissions by up to 90 percent and improve their environmental performance by using HVO. With stricter regulations for carbon emissions being introduced, converting to HVO can be a useful technology to bridge the gap in climate protection efforts. Companies that do so will not need to buy new electric forklift trucks when their diesel forklift trucks are still fully functional. The experts at Linde Material Handling will be happy to advise you on if and when it makes sense to switch to HVO.
The driver can perform all driving and mast functions quickly and precisely in any situation thanks to the hydrostatic drive and Linde Load Control.
Optimal all-round visibility and a range of assistance systems provide greater safety in the driver's day-to-day work.
The size of the cab and its layout are based on automotive standards, and provide the best environment for fast, relaxed work.
The Linde hydrostatic drive operates without a transmission, clutch, differential, or brakes, thus reducing consumption and ensuring low service costs.

The combination of the hydrostatic drive and robust engine really comes to the fore in challenging continuous operation with extensive operating hours. Many components are almost or entirely maintenance-free.

Every application is different. That's why Linde offers a special service whereby various construction variants, add-ons, and even tailored solutions are available for each diesel forklift product line. As a result, every forklift is ideally equipped to meet the specific requirements of Linde customers, who can fully exploit the performance potential of their truck. Linde also develops needs-based solutions to take into account customer requirements that extend beyond the series options. A special extra service: Linde can even retrofit existing vehicles with a range of extras, from heating and AC to integrated side shifters or LED work headlamps. In this way, entire fleets can be retrofitted in line with changes in their usage conditions.
A diesel forklift is a type of industrial truck with an on-board diesel engine. Diesel forklifts are only operated by a single person, and are used to transport general cargo.

If you have found the perfect diesel forklift, we would be happy to advise you on how to finance the vehicle of your choice. Whether you're looking for a temporary helper during order volume peaks or a core vehicle for continuous operation, Linde offers the right hire, lease, or buy package for every requirement. You can obtain a comprehensive overview of all the options by contacting the Linde consulting service.

For the past five years, a Linde H120 D has been hard at work at Norrlands trä in Älandsbro, about 400 kilometers north of Stockholm. The fleet has recently been expanded by the addition of another similar workhorse, which despite its size and weight, performs at a high level of precision.

The standard medication boxes available on the market often have quite a story behind them. For example, they may have once been a drinks carton and therefore more or less come straight from your rubbish bin. Transforming them into something valuable and appealing, doesn’t take much at Barcelona Cartonboard: a separating facility, a paper machine – and a dozen high-performance forklift trucks.

During peak loading times at the Rygol GmbH & Co. KG lime works in Painten, a Linde H25 truck can be seen in full swing. For this SME in Lower Bavaria, cost-effectiveness and user-friendliness are paramount: Their trucks must be able to withstand 16-hour shifts. Not a problem for the H25.

At BOHAI TRIMET GmBH in Sömmerda, the new H30 must withstand scorching heat and poor air conditions. As the only forklift with a rotary device, it works 24/7 to supply smelting furnaces for the production of vehicle parts. A key benefit of this truck is the Linde lighting concept in combination with its outstanding all-round visibility and smooth hydraulics.
High handling performance, reduced service costs, and safe handling processes: all guaranteed by the Linde Material Handling H50 – H80 diesel forklift trucks.
Linde Material Handling supports the automotive industry in the key challenges of intralogistics: ensuring production flow, saving costs, using automation, protecting the environment.
